sessionIsolation.reason: Exact main identity and only child sessions bound by its native subagent.started events; foreign captures are excluded.

requiredGates.reason: Invoice full-suite and acceptance gates remain required/local, the full panel remains configured, and neither explicit captured gate escapes nor the native bypass ledger may relax the workflow.

frozenPayload.reason: Current run-local payload compared with every frozen digest.

pluginRoot.reason: Every captured plugin root must be this run's frozen payload.

globalIntegrity.reason: Compare captured before/after global and marketplace hashes; do not inspect ambient global files.

workflowClosure.reason: Requires exact-session native state and a successful ticket-qualified chain-done call.

editLanding.reason: Final current-session, bound-log edit-landing receipt must remain clean. Historical pending/unverified markers are retained separately and never overwritten by closure state.

editLandingScope.reason: Scope identity, certified claims, append-only log prefix and current snapshots checked; Read-only native Git inventory plus independently hashed current blobs and executable modes.

treeCheck.reason: Read-only native Git inventory plus independently hashed current blobs and executable modes.

editLandingContext.reason: Omitting a repeated flag is valid only when current certified scope preserves the previously pending paths. A clean boolean alone cannot erase historical pending context.

persistedScope.reason: Scope identity, certified claims, append-only log prefix and current snapshots checked; Read-only native Git inventory plus independently hashed current blobs and executable modes.

treeCheck.reason: Read-only native Git inventory plus independently hashed current blobs and executable modes.

executionStart.reason: One generation marker and a successful native start must precede the first observed source-edit tool.

evidence.limitation: Shell-based source mutations are not inferred from arbitrary command text.

progress.reason: Both managed native status and original stage rows must agree; a managed checkbox alone is insufficient.

nativeReviewChain.reason: Requires completed native worker results, the first five-aspect panel, both first judges and primary-before-consume ordering.

canonicalPackets.reason: Every reference is rehashed; native injected bytes must be identical within each packet generation.

terminalSelfReview.reason: Native self-review loads after convergence and before closure. Repeated explicit skill invocations fail. Bounded native file reads are not themselves extra invocations. A later entry read requires a closed report-only response and no further work.

reviewRouting.reason: Quality verdict must not invent a routing directive. Missing captured hook guidance requires manual assessment.

nativeEvidenceRecords.reason: Exact native helper references, capture hashes, latest full-suite and four final criterion records agree on the independently checked current tree.

currentTree.reason: Read-only native Git inventory plus independently hashed current blobs and executable modes.

acceptance.reason: Four observed per-criterion records and a successful 4/4 status require either status-after-edit ordering or independently validated current-tree native records. Stale/failing status output is never overridden.

independentConsumer.reason: Original acceptance assertions, offline packaged installation and final source/installed digest equality; prior one-MiB comparisons are separate.

eventCompleteness.reason: Invalid/trailing JSONL records prevent a complete final assertion.

processExit.reason: A clean process exit is necessary but never sufficient for workflow success.

WF-001.reason: Only actual malformed-binding errors fail. Pre-hook repeated prefixes are observable replay candidates, but can be a host retry echo and do not establish model authorship. Injected execution_start prefixes are expected.

WF-002.reason: Canonical packet use is observed; untracked/unborn/mid-commit edge cases remain deterministic-test coverage.

WF-003.reason: Unlanded-edit recovery is not proven by an ordinary run; dropping pending dirty-before context is a related audit-evidence failure.

WF-004.reason: Observed reviewers use native tasks; unsupported external import branches were not exercised.

WF-005.reason: Actual native oversized-read responses, including audit references, are counted even if later recovered.

WF-006.reason: Failure-diagnostic quality needs a failing synthetic assertion; green checks alone do not demonstrate it.

WF-007.reason: Native start ordering and all completed-stage progress rows must agree.

WF-008.reason: Exact injected payload hashes and byte hashes are compared within each review packet.

WF-009.reason: Successful additive review never substitutes for substantive primary completion.

WF-010.reason: Structured input and exact summary/input counts are required; unresolved shell variables or absent finding files stay unassessed. Delimiter-injection negative cases remain deterministic coverage.

WF-011.reason: Quality reporting and the authoritative post-hook routing must remain distinct.

WF-012.reason: A reused acceptance record with separate AC observations demonstrates sharing; distinct records alone do not prove redundant commands.

WF-013.reason: Bound closure and final reporting must not restart the terminal skill.

limits: No model, workflow helper, shell interpreter, state transition or ambient credential/configuration read is performed; bounded read-only Git inventory commands are permitted for the named invoice project.
Source-only and negative branches can remain unexercised; this report never upgrades fixtures to live evidence.
A superseded run remains its own result; multiple runs never share completion proof.
